rfp_requirements.title: Prohibition on Payments to State Officers/Employees
rfp_requirements.description: No vendor shall pay, offer to pay, or agree to pay, directly or indirectly, any fee, commission, compensation, gift, gratuity, or other thing of value to any State officer or employee, special State officer or employee, or their immediate family, or associated entities.

rfp_requirements.title: Describe secure code development processes
rfp_requirements.description: As applicable, describe processes used to ensure code is being developed securely, including types of code reviews and analysis (static and dynamic) and how threat modeling is incorporated into design.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide detailed two-week mobilization timetable
rfp_requirements.description: The Mobilization Plan shall include a detailed timetable for the mobilization period of two (2) weeks, demonstrating how the Bidder will have personnel and equipment operational from the date of notification of award.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide draft plans to accomplish all work required by Contract
rfp_requirements.description: The Bidder shall provide its draft plans to accomplish all work required by this Contract, demonstrating understanding of the Scope of Work for successful implementation, operations, maintenance, and support.

rfp_requirements.title: Account for Labor Costs
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must account for labor costs per Section 4.10.1.

rfp_requirements.title: Bear all costs for fingerprinting process
rfp_requirements.description: The Contractor shall be responsible for any costs associated with and/or incurred by the fingerprinting process.

rfp_requirements.title: Include alert notification and escalation policies
Secure application infrastructure & hosting facilities
Establish Link 1 to OIT HUB Primary Data Center
Establish Link 2 to Hamilton Data Center
Maintain audit-quality records of PI expenditures
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must demonstrate PI funds are used exclusively for public information purposes and maintain audit quality records available to State for SCM review and auditing.

rfp_requirements.title: Address payment of final invoices, retainage, release of insurance and Performance Bond in Plan
Do not operate the SIFs
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor shall not operate the SIFs; all SIF operations remain with the State.

rfp_requirements.title: Contractor has sole responsibility for complete effort
Establish risk identification, assessment, and treatment requirements
rfp_requirements.description: Bidder must establish requirements for the identification, assessment, and treatment of information security risks to operations, information, and/or information systems.

rfp_requirements.title: Receive Payments Electronically via NJSTART EFT
rfp_requirements.description: Receive payment(s) electronically and complete the EFT information within the NJSTART Vendor Profile to receive automatic deposit payments from the State.

rfp_requirements.title: Obtain prior written consent of Director before assigning responsibilities
Make deliveries at times/quantities per contract
Deliver material in first class condition per good commercial practice
Deliver items strictly in accordance with contract
Default delivery 30 calendar days ARO F.O.B. Destination
C.O.D. terms not accepted
NJ law governs; file in NJ Superior Court
Contract amendments must be written and agreed
Maintain records for 5 years from final payment
Cooperate with State record/audit requests and provide records free of charge
Assign antitrust claims to State of New Jersey
Notify defendants of assignment in antitrust suits
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must notify defendants in any antitrust suit of the assignment to the State at the earliest practicable opportunity, and send a copy of the notice to the NJ Attorney General.

rfp_requirements.title: Obtain prior written consent for news releases
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must not issue any news releases about services under the Contract without prior written consent of the Director.

rfp_requirements.title: Disseminate organ donation information to employees
rfp_requirements.description: The State encourages the contractor to disseminate organ donation information and to notify its employees of organ donation options through materials or an awareness program, prepared in collaboration with designated organ procurement organizations.

rfp_requirements.title: Continue performance during Initial Transition Period up to 365 days
Force Majeure relief and extension of performance time
Describe risk management processes and frequency
rfp_requirements.description: Bidder must describe risk management processes for identification, assessment, and treatment of risks impacting confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the product/system/application/service, and how often these processes are performed.

rfp_requirements.title: Continue Performance During Initial Transition Period Beyond Expiration
rfp_requirements.description: If no new contract is awarded prior to expiration, the Contractor shall continue performance under the same terms, conditions, and pricing during the Initial Transition Period beyond the expiration date (including extensions) if the Director determines it is in the best interest of the State.

rfp_requirements.title: Continue Performance Up to 365 Days During NCA Transition
rfp_requirements.description: Upon written notice, Contractor shall continue performance under the same terms, conditions, and pricing for up to 365 Calendar Days beyond contract expiration or until the new contract is operational, whichever is first.

rfp_requirements.title: Obtain and maintain required licenses, permits, and authorizations
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must obtain and maintain in full force and effect all required licenses, permits, and authorizations necessary to perform the Contract.

rfp_requirements.title: State confidentiality obligations subject to OPRA and common law right to know
rfp_requirements.description: The State's confidentiality obligations under the Contract are subject to the New Jersey Open Public Records Act (OPRA), N.J.S.A. 47:1A-1 et seq., the New Jersey common law right to know, and any other lawful document request or subpoena.

rfp_requirements.title: Limit disclosure to information required for performance
rfp_requirements.description: The parties must disclose to each other only information required for the performance of their obligations under the Contract.

rfp_requirements.title: Scope of State's Confidential Information
rfp_requirements.description: The State's Confidential Information consists of all information or data contained in documents supplied by the State, any information or data gathered by the Contractor in fulfillment of the Contract, and any analysis thereof (whether in fulfillment of the Contract or not).

rfp_requirements.title: Exclusions from Confidential Information
rfp_requirements.description: Confidential Information does not include information that (a) enters the public domain through no act or omission of the other party (with continued protection for personally identifying information); (b) was in the other party's lawful possession prior to disclosure and not obtained from the discl

rfp_requirements.title: Hold Confidential Information with due care
rfp_requirements.description: The State and Contractor must hold each other's Confidential Information in confidence using at least the same degree of care used to protect its own Confidential Information.

rfp_requirements.title: State to notify Contractor of legal requests for Contractor Confidential Information
rfp_requirements.description: If the State receives a court order, subpoena, or other legal request for Contractor Confidential Information, the State agrees, if permitted by law, to provide Contractor with as much written notice as is reasonably practicable along with the State's intended response so the Contractor may take act

rfp_requirements.title: Notify State of legal requests for its Confidential Information
rfp_requirements.description: If Contractor receives a court order, subpoena, or other legal request for State Confidential Information, Contractor must, if permitted, give the State as much written notice as reasonably practicable and its intended response.

rfp_requirements.title: Permitted release of Confidential Information by court order or subpoena
rfp_requirements.description: Either party may release the other party's Confidential Information if directed by a court or arbitrator of competent jurisdiction, or pursuant to a lawfully issued subpoena/other lawful document request, subject to the notice procedures in 5.23(F) and (G) regarding whether the other party exercised

rfp_requirements.title: Debarment/suspension exclusion notice
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor is advised it may be excluded from contract award consideration due to debarment, suspension, or disqualification under Executive Order 34 (1976), applied universally across state contracting.

rfp_requirements.title: Resolve State wage/benefit/tax violations before contracting
rfp_requirements.description: Per N.J.S.A. 34:1A-1.16 et seq., any person found in violation of State wage, benefit, or tax laws with a final order issued is prohibited from contracting with any public body until liabilities are resolved to the Commissioner's satisfaction.

rfp_requirements.title: Describe risk evaluation, prioritization, and verification
rfp_requirements.description: Bidder must describe how risks and risk mitigation efforts are evaluated and prioritized, including details on documenting and verifying results of these risk mitigation processes.

rfp_requirements.title: Changes must be in writing and signed by Contractor and Director
Optional additional information - Risk Management
rfp_requirements.description: Bidder may optionally provide any additional information relative to the Risk Management (RM) control area.

rfp_requirements.title: Acknowledge State Ownership of State Data
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor shall not obtain any right, title, or interest in any State Data or information derived from or based on State Data.

rfp_requirements.title: Submit additional information and negotiate adjusted price if disagreeing
Submit itemization of work effort already completed
Grant State Non-Exclusive License to Contractor Intellectual Property
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor shall grant the State a non-exclusive, royalty-free license to use Contractor Intellectual Property delivered to the State for the duration of the Contract, including all extensions.

rfp_requirements.title: Ensure Standard License Terms Comply with Order of Precedence
rfp_requirements.description: If Contractor provides its standard license agreement terms with its Quote, such terms and conditions must comply with Bid Solicitation Section 1.4 – Order of Precedence of Contractual Terms.

rfp_requirements.title: Secure Third Party Intellectual Property License on State's Behalf
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor shall secure on the State's behalf, in the name of the State and subject to State approval, a license to Third Party Intellectual Property sufficient to fulfill requirements at no additional cost beyond the Quote price.

rfp_requirements.title: Comply with complaints procedure in N.J.A.C. 17:12-4.2 et seq.
Make progress to ameliorate complaint issues to avoid termination
Contractor compensated for work performed up to date of termination
Secure Written SCM Approvals Prior to Related Work
rfp_requirements.description: The Contractor must secure all written approvals from the SCM prior to the start of any related work.

rfp_requirements.title: Obtain prior written consent of Director before subcontracting
Keep detailed sales records for Using Agencies
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must maintain records of all sales to Using Agencies in sufficient detail to determine the Procurement Efficiency Program Fee owed.

rfp_requirements.title: Annual Recalculation of Performance Bond Based on Outstanding Balance
rfp_requirements.description: For performance bonds based on a percentage of total estimated Contract price, on each anniversary of the effective date of the Contract, the required performance bond amount is recalculated by applying the established RFQ performance bond percentage to the outstanding balance of the estimated Contr

rfp_requirements.title: Hold prices firm through Contract period
rfp_requirements.description: Unless otherwise agreed in writing, all quoted prices must be firm through issuance of the contract or purchase order and not subject to increase during the contract period.

rfp_requirements.title: Use tailored acquisition strategies for suppliers
rfp_requirements.description: Use tailored acquisition strategies, contracting tools, and procurement methods for purchases from suppliers.

rfp_requirements.title: Exclude State sales/use and Federal excise taxes from price quotations
rfp_requirements.description: The State is exempt from State sales/use and Federal excise taxes, so price quotations must not include such taxes.

rfp_requirements.title: Submit invoices with supporting documentation
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must submit invoices to the using agency with supporting documentation evidencing that work or goods have been satisfactorily completed or delivered.

rfp_requirements.title: Reference task/subtask or price line numbers on invoices
rfp_requirements.description: When applicable, invoices should reference the appropriate task or subtask or price line number from the contractor's proposal.

rfp_requirements.title: Use State Data only for enumerated Contract purposes
rfp_requirements.description: All State Data shall be used expressly and solely for the purposes enumerated in the Contract and shall not be distributed, repurposed, or shared across other applications, environments, or business units.

rfp_requirements.title: Cooperate with State to prevent Breach disclosure when legally compelled
rfp_requirements.description: If legally required to provide notification or disclosure regarding a Breach, Contractor must consult with the State and reasonably cooperate with the State to prevent any notification or disclosure concerning any Personal Data or Breach of Security.

rfp_requirements.title: Collaborate on GSN remote access requirements
rfp_requirements.description: If approved to use State-provided remote access to the Garden State Network, Contractor must collaborate with the State per defined usage restrictions, configuration requirements, and implementation guidance.

rfp_requirements.title: Indemnify State in third-party suits
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must indemnify, defend, and save harmless the State and its officers, agents, servants, and employees from any third-party claims, demands, suits, actions, recoveries, judgments, and costs/expenses.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide IP remedy options for infringement claims
rfp_requirements.description: In the event of a third-party IP claim, Contractor may at its option: (1) procure the legal right to continue use; (2) replace/modify with non-infringing equivalent; or (3) refund purchase price less reasonable allowance for use.

rfp_requirements.title: State responsibility subject to NJ Tort Claims Act and Contractual Liability Act
rfp_requirements.description: Subject to the New Jersey Tort Claims Act (N.J.S.A. 59:1-1 et seq.), the New Jersey Contractual Liability Act (N.J.S.A. 59:13-1 et seq.), and appropriation/availability of funds, the State will be responsible for costs/damages arising out of its own actions/inactions under Section 4.1(A)(1)(i), (ii)

rfp_requirements.title: Contractor liability cap acknowledgment
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor's liability for actual, direct damages is limited in the aggregate to 200% of the fees paid by the State during the previous twelve months for the products or services giving rise to damages, but in no event less than $1,000,000. This cap does not apply to indemnification obligations or c

rfp_requirements.title: Make Maximum Use of EPA-Designated Recovered Materials
rfp_requirements.description: In performance of the contract, make maximum use of products containing recovered materials that are EPA-designated items unless the product cannot be acquired competitively within the performance schedule, meeting performance requirements, or at a reasonable price.

rfp_requirements.title: Pay Prevailing Wages
rfp_requirements.description: Pay wages to laborers and mechanics at a rate not less than the prevailing wages specified in a wage determination made by the Secretary of Labor.

rfp_requirements.title: Submit best technical and price Quote initially
rfp_requirements.description: Bidder is advised to submit its best technical and price Quote in response to the Bid Solicitation because the State may make a Contract award based on the content of the initial submission without further negotiation.

rfp_requirements.title: Submit most competitive Quote; BAFO may not be requested
rfp_requirements.description: Bidder is advised to submit its most competitive technical and price Quote. The State reserves the right to award without requesting a BAFO; BAFOs not resulting in more advantageous pricing will not be considered.

rfp_requirements.title: Recommendation for Award process
rfp_requirements.description: After evaluation is complete, the Procurement Bureau will recommend to the Director the responsible Bidder(s) whose Quote, conforming to the Bid Solicitation, is most advantageous to the State, price and other factors considered. The Director may accept, reject, or modify the recommendation.

rfp_requirements.title: Indemnify the State against third-party claims (IT contracts)
rfp_requirements.description: Assume all risk and responsibility and indemnify, defend, and save harmless the State of New Jersey and its officers, officials, agents, servants and employees from and against any and all third-party claims, demands, suits, actions, recoveries, judgments and costs and expenses arising from loss of

rfp_requirements.title: Remedies for third-party IP infringement claims
rfp_requirements.description: In the event of a patent/copyright claim involving third-party IP rights, at Contractor's option: procure the legal right for the State to continue use; replace/modify the product with a non-infringing functional equivalent; or refund the purchase price less a reasonable allowance for use.

rfp_requirements.title: State responsibility limited by NJ Tort Claims Act and Contractual Liability Act
rfp_requirements.description: Subject to the New Jersey Tort Claims Act (N.J.S.A. 59:1-1 et seq.), the New Jersey Contractual Liability Act (N.J.S.A. 59:13-1 et seq.), and appropriation and availability of funds, the State will be responsible for any cost or damage arising out of actions/inactions of the State, its employees or

rfp_requirements.title: Remedy for breach of IT Services warranty
rfp_requirements.description: On breach, contractor shall re-perform the deficient Services; if unable to substantially correct, the State may end the Services and recover the fees paid for the deficient Services.

rfp_requirements.title: UL-listed electrical equipment
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor warrants that all equipment supplied to the State operated by electrical current is UL listed where applicable.

rfp_requirements.title: Hardware warranty remedy: repair, replace, or refund
rfp_requirements.description: On breach of the Hardware warranty, the contractor shall promptly repair, replace or refund the purchase price of product rejected for failure to conform with the contractor's product specifications.

rfp_requirements.title: Audit dispute resolution – appoint Representative
rfp_requirements.description: If a dispute arises over audit-related alleged underpaid fees, each party will appoint a Vice President, Assistant Director, or equivalent Representative to resolve the dispute; no formal judicial proceedings may begin (except equitable relief or to avoid non-compliance with NJ Contractual Liability

rfp_requirements.title: State not liable for audit costs
rfp_requirements.description: Notwithstanding anything to the contrary, the State will not reimburse the contractor for any costs related to an audit.

rfp_requirements.title: Indemnify State for third-party claims
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must assume all risk and responsibility and indemnify, defend, and save harmless the State of New Jersey and its officers, officials, agents, servants and employees from all third-party claims, demands, suits, actions, recoveries, judgments and costs.

rfp_requirements.title: Remedy third-party IP infringement claims
rfp_requirements.description: In the event of a third-party Intellectual Property Rights claim, Contractor at its option must procure the legal right to continue use, replace/modify to a non-infringing equivalent, or refund the purchase price less reasonable use allowance.

rfp_requirements.title: Limitation of liability cap - 200% of fees / $1M minimum
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor's liability to the State for actual, direct damages for all third-party claims is limited in the aggregate to 200% of fees paid by the State during the previous twelve months for the products/services giving rise to the damages, but in no event less than $1,000,000. This cap does not appl

rfp_requirements.title: Per-record cost cap based on Ponemon Institute study
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor's cost-bearing obligations for Breach of Security from encryption failure are not to exceed the average per record, per person cost calculated for data breaches in the United States in the most recent Cost of Data Breach Study: Global Analysis published by the Ponemon Institute for the pu

rfp_requirements.title: Complete corrective actions after Breach
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor shall complete all corrective actions as reasonably determined by Contractor based on root cause of the Breach of Security (part of costs borne where breach results from Contractor's encryption obligation breach).

rfp_requirements.title: Obtain voluntary written dues authorization (Exhibit A)
rfp_requirements.description: Upon receipt of a voluntary written authorization from an Employee in the form annexed as Exhibit A, the Employer shall deduct regular monthly dues and a non-refundable initiation fee.

rfp_requirements.title: Pay 1.5x for overtime beyond regular workweek
rfp_requirements.description: Employees must be paid 1.5 times regular rate for authorized time worked in excess of the regular full-time workweek for their classification.

rfp_requirements.title: Temporarily promote senior ALT when no Lane Tech available
rfp_requirements.description: If no Senior Lane Technician or Lane Technician is available to work in each lane, the Employer may temporarily promote the most senior Associate Lane Technician for the shift at the current Lane Technician rate, regardless of discipline record.

rfp_requirements.title: Honor overtime requests in lower classifications
rfp_requirements.description: If more volunteers than needed in a classification, an employee may request overtime in a lower classification; request honored only after all employees in lower class have been offered and declined; employee paid overtime based on regular rate but performs lower-class duties.

rfp_requirements.title: Pay minimum 2 hours for emergency overtime call-in
rfp_requirements.description: Any employee called in for emergency overtime outside normal hours must be paid 1.5x for a minimum of 2 hours whether or not 2 hours are worked; pay period commences upon arrival.

rfp_requirements.title: Pay holiday overtime rates
rfp_requirements.description: Employees called in for overtime on a recognized holiday must be paid 1.5x regular rate for hours worked plus holiday pay (8 hours straight-time for FT, 5 hours straight-time for PT).

rfp_requirements.title: Pay 1.5x for Saturday overtime
rfp_requirements.description: Employees called in for overtime on Saturdays must be paid 1.5 times regular rate for all hours worked on Saturday.

rfp_requirements.title: Pay 2x and minimum 4 hours for Sunday overtime
rfp_requirements.description: Employees called in for overtime on Sundays must be paid 2 times regular rate for hours worked and be guaranteed a minimum of 4 hours pay.

rfp_requirements.title: Part-Time Employees accrue seniority at half rate
rfp_requirements.description: Part-Time Employees shall accrue seniority at one-half (1/2) the rate of Full-Time Employees.

rfp_requirements.title: Preserve pay rate upon involuntary displacement
rfp_requirements.description: Any employee involuntarily displaced into a lower paying classification must keep their current rate of pay.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide salary adjustment upon promotion
rfp_requirements.description: An employee who is promoted must receive a salary adjustment to the pay grade of the position; employees already at or above the new grade receive the new title rate plus the differential between previous and new titles.

rfp_requirements.title: Apply wage rates per Appendix A
rfp_requirements.description: The applicable wage rates for all employees during the contract term are set forth in Appendix A.

rfp_requirements.title: Pay overtime rate during State of Emergency in affected county
rfp_requirements.description: During a declared State of Emergency or Executive Order closing State offices in a particular County, employees at affected stations remaining in operation must be paid at 1.5 times their regular rate.

rfp_requirements.title: Avoid patterns of absenteeism
rfp_requirements.description: Employees demonstrating a pattern of absenteeism (e.g., calling out on Monday or Friday twice in a 30-day period, leaving early two times in a work week, leaving early three times in 30 days, or taking the same day off three times in 30 days) may be subject to discipline.

rfp_requirements.title: Maintain separate transfer request lists for specified classifications
rfp_requirements.description: Transfer requests by Part-Time Equipment Repair Technicians, Technical Specialists, and Material Handlers unit Employees shall be maintained on a separate list from Full-Time Employees, subject to the same procedural rules.

rfp_requirements.title: Defend and cooperate in defense of non-disclosure actions
rfp_requirements.description: Company agrees that it shall defend and cooperate in the defense of an action against the State of New Jersey arising from or related to the non-disclosure, due to the Company's request, of documents submitted to the State.

rfp_requirements.title: Continuing cooperation in defense or risk immediate disclosure
rfp_requirements.description: If Company ceases to cooperate in the defense of an action arising from non-disclosure, the State may immediately disclose any documents withheld without further notice, and will disclose such documents if ordered by a court of competent jurisdiction.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide detailed description of Iran investment activities if applicable
rfp_requirements.description: If unable to certify because Vendor/Bidder or one or more parents, subsidiaries, or affiliates is listed on the Chapter 25 List, Bidder must provide a detailed, accurate and precise description of the activities, including entity engaged, relationship to Vendor/Bidder, description of activities, dur
rfp_requirements.section: Disclosure of Investment Activities in Iran Form

rfp_requirements.title: Implement security and privacy controls commensurate with State data sensitivity
rfp_requirements.description: All vendors, business partners, and other third-parties are required to implement security and privacy controls that are commensurate with the criticality and sensitivity of the State of New Jersey information systems and information they develop, implement, provide, manage, host, or access.

rfp_requirements.title: Indicate if Vendor is a Sole Proprietor
rfp_requirements.description: Vendor must indicate whether it is a Sole Proprietor (a natural person who owns an unincorporated business by himself or herself; a single-member LLC is NOT a Sole Proprietor); if so, no other disclosure is necessary.

rfp_requirements.title: Disclose tiered 10% or greater owners until all natural persons identified
rfp_requirements.description: For each corporation, partnership, or LLC identified at the first tier, Bidder must continue disclosing 10%-or-greater owners until the names and addresses of every non-corporate stockholder, individual partner, and/or member with a 10% or greater interest have been identified.

rfp_requirements.title: Record answer: current signs, licenses and rate charts posted in full public view
rfp_requirements.description: Auditor shall record yes/no/NA for: Are the current signs, licenses and rate charts posted in full public view? (PIF-specific fourth question)

rfp_requirements.title: Complete all required price lines
rfp_requirements.description: Bidders must complete all required price lines on the State-Supplied Price Sheet per the Bid Solicitation instructions or the Quote may be deemed non-responsive.

rfp_requirements.title: Identify data types accessed under the engagement
rfp_requirements.description: Select the data types that will be generated, accessed, processed, stored, and/or transmitted as part of the engagement (Public Data, PII, CJI, FTI, ePHI, SSA-Provided, Cardholder/Sensitive Authentication Data, or Other Sensitive Information).

rfp_requirements.title: Submit Supporting Documentation per Section V
rfp_requirements.description: Vendor must submit the supporting documentation enumerated in Section V – Supporting Documentation to be Submitted (referenced in the Table of Contents at page 30).

I-1. STATEMENT OF THE PROJECT
Pennsylvania operates one of the largest, longest-running decentralized Vehicle Emissions Inspection and Maintenance
(I/M) Programs in the United States. The Commonwealth’s I/M Program, divided into four regions, has grown to around
8,200 stations throughout 25 counties since 1997. PennDOT estimates nearly 7 million vehicles will be subject to
inspection by 2025. The Program design provides consumer convenience, supports private inspection stations, and
improves air quality. Stations in the Program are responsible for maintaining inspection equipment appropriate for the
required inspection types in the given region.
PennDOT is seeking a reliable, experienced Offeror to provide Emissions Program Management and continue the
successful operations of the I/M Program, overseeing safety inspection stations and related systems to keep consumer
and inspection station costs as low as possible while maintaining vehicle and consumer safety. The Program must
comply with federal and state requirements while providing adaptability for future Progr

l ensure the continued success of your Program through our strong foundational Program
knowledge and performance history of compliance and adaptability with no transition risk. We understand the need
for complete separation and no conflict of interest between PennDOT’s Emissions Program Manager and emissions
equipment providers. We are the only contractor that can guarantee no financial or business relationship with any
currently certified emissions testing equipment manufacturer in Pennsylvania.
The selected Program Manager will administer all aspects of the I/M Program under PennDOT’s direction, including the
required services defined in the RFP and outlined in work statement Part I-6. The contractor’s responsibilities include:
§ Maintaining the nature and scope of Pennsylvania’s current I/M Program
§ Maintaining required geographic coverage and program areas
§ Providing a seamless transition that prevents interruption in Program services or data collection by maintaining
interfaces with hardware and software and ensuring emission testing equipment transmits data to the Vehicle
Information Inspection Database (VIID) identically
§ Providing for the storage and handling of all I/M

d safety inspection data
§ Providing the necessary software/hardware to operate and maintain the I/M Program
§ Providing a disaster recovery plan
§ Providing data back-up and off-site back-up storage
§ Providing system journal files (transaction journals), logging all system transactions
§ Overseeing (overt, covert, and remote visual observation) I/M and Safety stations within the assigned geographic
